frozen_eval.note: Frozen eval_set run predates the 0.6 threshold decision. accuracy/macro_f1 above are argmax-based and unaffected by threshold (threshold only gates status=accepted/uncertain, not the prediction itself). Re-deriving accepted-only accuracy at 0.6 would require touching eval_set predictions again - do not do this; treat 0.6 as the deployment threshold going forward, informed by the validation sweep.
